question: How many times has India won gold in men's hockey at the Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Eight__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian Hockey in Olympics:
 
• The number of Gold Medals won by Indian Hockey in the Olympics is eight. 
 
 
• India won gold medals in hockey in the following years: **1928, 1932, 1936, 1948, 1952, 1956, 1964, and 1980.**
 
 
 
• The number of Silver Medals won by Indian Hockey in the Olympics is one in 1960.
 
• The number of Bronze Medals won by Indian Hockey in the Olympics is three. (1968,1972 and 2020).

​Thus, the Indian Hockey team has won 8 Gold Medals in Olympics.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Field Hockey:

 
 
• Field Hockey is a team game.
 
• It is played between two teams of 11 players each.
 
• It is played with the help of a hockey stick and a ball.
 
• A hockey stick is equipment used to play hockey.
 
• It consists of mainly four parts i.e., grip, shaft, heel, and toe.
 
• The ball should way between 5.5 to 5.75 ounces.
 
• The "International Hockey Federation" makes the rules.
